newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stock seen rising on relax of rule.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stock seen rising on relax of rule.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may extend their recent rally and brokers said market sentiment might be boosted further after the DSE relaxed the rule limiting price movement within 10 percent range.
"The share prices may move up amid heavy demand from the small investors. The new steps by the DSE will boost the market sentiment," said broker Sabbir Ahmed.
The DSE on Sunday announced it was relaxing the rule for three days for a listed company which released market moving news such as results, dividends or tie-up with foreign firms.
